index_title: Exact trace geometry, canonical old gates and AP-only quotient safe towers
scope: Private B062: all EIGHT exact-trace-geometry source results, THIRTEEN auxiliary equations, fourteen definitions, 112 expanded human claims and twelve implementation tasks. Actual AP+HOM CCO full-character towers preserve nonempty RAW exact trace products, exact-equivalence lifts and finite type supports. Connected steps have ONE canonical ORIGINAL gate; their meet is the largest exact label kernel. Every original exact quotient carries the genuine full admissible safe tower, with precisely the E-not-below-G steps discarded, objectwise character correction on retained occupancy graphs, full finite-age converse, reachable maximal projected gates and terminality. No quotient SAP, arbitrary mixed reverse exact descent, or EP inherited from an arbitrary quotient is assumed. One required RAW-provider citation correction is exposed; no formula or hypothesis is changed.
scope_explanation: One ORIGINAL symmetric transitive source supplies commutation of all old invariant relations. Prefix sorts and quotient occupancy sorts are actual homogeneous named carriers. Products are equality-inclusive RAW represented relations; middle trace sorts are literal and both input traces are nonempty.

assumptions.name: One original actual symmetric AP+HOM CCO source
assumptions.statement: M is a nonempty countable transitive homogeneous source in a finite complete named symmetric binary language of actual orbitals. Its age has ordinary AP and semantic HOM simple-cycle CCO. Every invariant old relation is a finite orbital union; logical identity is included in RAW products and is never a diversity edge. No SAP is imposed.

assumptions.name: Specified genuine finite safe tower
assumptions.statement: Choose a finite succession of the ACTUAL maximal-exact-complement FULL connected rigid-groupoid character constructions of the AP-only provider. Each prefix is its genuine homogeneous marked-age limit, identified over its old reduct by reasonableness. All allowed finite markings, not an arbitrary single seed marking or one selected orbit, are retained. Active masks/gates and inactive fixed labels are the actual provider construction.

assumptions.name: Optional terminal starting tower
assumptions.statement: ONLY for the last terminality implication, every strict cover in the FULL invariant-equivalence lattice on each final nonempty parent sort has infinite relative index. This concerns all invariant equivalences, not only exact ones.

assumptions.name: Bound original exact quotient kernel
assumptions.statement: For the quotient theorem choose any ORIGINAL full exact invariant equivalence E, including Id or Top. Quotient points are actual E-classes and quotient atoms are their actual saturated original orbital blocks. No SAP, section of automorphism groups, or arbitrary mixed reverse exact descent is supplied by this parameter.

assumptions.name: Optional nonidentity kernel for strict rank
assumptions.statement: ONLY for the auxiliary diversity-rank observation assume E>Id on the original carrier. This is not required for the quotient-tower theorem.

imports.name: thm:full-typed-exact-balls
imports.statement: The equality-inclusive RAW exact calculus closes nonempty exact domains under represented convolution and distributes exact factors over finite exact meets with NONEMPTY evaluation. In particular E;D;E=intersection_r E;P_r;E for a nonempty exact presentation D=intersection_r P_r. This is the required AP-only RAW provider, not the STRONG-only lemma sharing an old saturation citation.

imports.name: lem:ep-ap-TP
imports.statement: For the genuine AP-only full-character step, actual allowed atomic forks satisfy (T), and nonempty old exact profile intersections satisfy mask primality (P). Logical identity outputs and relative-K closures are handled by the proved provider; no SAP saturation is used.

imports.name: thm:ep-ap-marked-completion
imports.statement: An ACTUAL old finite complete object has legal pair masks iff its bits extend to a global character marking. Reasonableness lifts the SAME embedding. Its genuine marked Fraisse age is homogeneous with unchanged old reduct and HOM CCO. An arbitrary global seed marking is not itself assumed homogeneous.

imports.name: cor:ep-ap-safe-splitting
imports.statement: The actual AP-only maximal-character split exists for a finite relative interval; its marked AP/JEP/HOM CCO iteration terminates. This binds the specified safe tower construction at every actual prefix without assuming SAP of exact quotients.

imports.name: prop:lattice-interface
imports.statement: In the independent finite symmetric original-sort setting, invariant equivalences form a finite FULL lattice with actual intersection and represented commuting product as join. This independent branch assumes no clones, SAP or CCO; its source parameters are discharged by A01 or each actual prefix sort.

imports.name: lem:ep-ap-orbital-parity
imports.statement: Actual symmetric orbital walk powers stabilize; a finite-index-separated atom has nonempty exact even/odd profiles Y,O with X=Y union O and [X:Y]=2. X need not be exact. Products include the logical diagonal; no extra identity-coloured diversity edges occur.

imports.name: thm:foundational-maximal-parity-gate
imports.statement: For a maximal full exact complement K of a reachable Y<X of index two, the WHOLE selected odd K-quotient involution t lies in every full exact equivalence strictly above K. Its real relation need not be functional; only t/K is. Quotient word inverse images are full exact.

imports.name: thm:foundational-rigid-character
imports.statement: The actual connected rigid quotient groupoid is free. Rigid arrows are whole quotient orbitals, every other orbital joins different free-action orbits, and the full character sends the selected odd involution to one. No preferred seed or generic higher-owner action is provided.

imports.name: lem:foundational-finite-phase-extension
imports.statement: On finitely many ACTUAL groupoid quotient points, prescribed bits extend to ONE global marking iff all same-action-orbit pair differences equal the character. Duplicate quotient points must receive the same bit; independent action orbits have independent seeds.

imports.name: lem:typed-simultaneous-blocks
imports.statement: Actual quotient atoms pull back to nonempty exact saturated orbital blocks. Pullback preserves converse, intersections and compatible RAW composition; quotient equality pulls back to the WHOLE kernel. Quotient exact words pull back exact, including empty-word kernel rather than old Id. No arbitrary mixed reverse descent is asserted.

imports.name: lem:foundational-rigid-quotient-bridge
imports.statement: If exact quotient kernels e_p refine the proposed gate kernels K_p and the projected gate kernels are already proved FULL exact, full exact K-bridges descend and EVERY full exact projected gate bridge pulls back. Correspondence preserves all compatible compositions and inverses. This is precise bridge-specific exact descent, not arbitrary typed saturated word descent; C82 establishes the projected-gate exactness before C83 applies this provider.

imports.name: lem:one-original-sort-exact-descent
imports.statement: A nonempty E-bisaturated full exact relation in ONE ORIGINAL SYMMETRIC sort descends to a quotient full exact relation; exact equivalences containing E do so in particular. The proof uses original one-sort commutation, and is not a theorem for independently quotiented original sorts.

imports.name: thm:typed-simultaneous-exact-quotients
imports.statement: For a homogeneous finite NAMED-SORTED actual AP+HOM CCO source with independently chosen nonempty full exact kernels, the simultaneously interpreted typed quotients have actual finite orbital language, triangle fullness, countable joint homogeneity/AP/JEP and semantic HOM CCO. This is applied to the NEW many-parent prefix M_j, not the older ONE_ORIGINAL_SORT exact-sorts-source theorem. No quotient SAP, group section or arbitrary mixed reverse exact descent is supplied.

definitions.name: RAW exact domains
definitions.statement: An exact domain is a finite intersection of reachable RAW endpoint profiles with nonempty evaluation; empty restriction list is typed Top and empty word is logical Id. Products use actual existential witnesses with compatible named endpoints.

definitions.name: Genuine safe prefix
definitions.statement: M_j is the actual homogeneous output of the preceding full-character stages, with all current unary types and the original old atom names retained.

definitions.name: Literal trace
definitions.statement: tr_uv(D)=D intersect (u x v) as a real relation; its represented composition quantifies its middle point inside the DISPLAYED current sort v.

definitions.name: Actual mask contracts
definitions.statement: A_uv is the allowed old atomic mask. (T) is lifted fork totality, (P) nonempty-profile primality, and (R) actual old-age pair/triangle realization with coherent marks.

definitions.name: Exact restriction map
definitions.statement: rho_p sends each original full exact equivalence H to H restricted to p squared, on the actual nonempty current sort.

definitions.name: Largest original exact lift
definitions.statement: L_p(F) is the finite join of ALL original exact-equivalence lifts having trace F; it is not an arbitrary old predecessor.

definitions.name: Original orbital parity
definitions.statement: For original bipartite c, Y_c,O_c are the stable even/odd RAW walk profiles and X_c=Y_c union O_c has index two over Y_c; X_c need not be exact.

definitions.name: Finite type support
definitions.statement: Phi_j(D) relates actual prefix types s,t iff some actual x in s,y in t satisfy old D. For Id it is literal type identity; a diversity loop uses DISTINCT points.

definitions.name: One connected old gate
definitions.statement: G_i is the common canonical largest ORIGINAL exact lift of the active current gates in one connected full-character step.

definitions.name: Common exact label kernel
definitions.statement: Kcom is the intersection of the finitely many original step gates G_i, with Top for no steps.

definitions.name: Exact quotient occupancy
definitions.statement: An E-class is labelled by the Phi_j(E)-class of precisely the prefix unary types it meets; the current quotient label set is T_j/Phi_j(E).

definitions.name: Objectwise phase correction
definitions.statement: For occupancy C choose p_C; the whole identity G-bridge I_pq has character cocycle. gamma_p=chi(I_pC,p), and zeta(X)=bit(x)+gamma_p for x in X intersect p.

definitions.name: Full finite quotient age
definitions.statement: Every pair-locally allowed new marked quotient diagram whose old PREFIX diagram is legal is realized in the actual new homogeneous quotient prefix, not only in one chosen global seed marking.

definitions.name: Original diversity rank
definitions.statement: Count original diversity orbitals before choosing any safe labels. A nonidentity exact quotient merges at least one old diversity orbital into equality and splits no old orbital.

claims.name: Actual step contracts are provided in AP-only semantics
claims.statement: Bind I02/I03 at each actual prefix from A01/A02: (T),(P),(R) are statements about actual old orbitals and full globally markable finite diagrams. Relative-K identity contractions remain in the provider; no SAP assumption is introduced.

claims.name: Old symmetry supplies represented commutation
claims.statement: Every old invariant relation is an orbital union and is symmetric. Its product with another invariant relation is again invariant and symmetric, so converse reversal gives D;F=F;D on the ONE original carrier. Nonempty invariant relations are serial by original transitivity. The full invariant equivalence lattice is finite by I05.

claims.name: Every finite prefix is an actual allowed homogeneous source
claims.statement: Inductively apply I03/I04 to the specified A02 construction: each prefix retains finite named transitive types, actual old pair orbitals, ordinary AP and HOM CCO, with the preceding reduct identified by reasonableness. Any later quotient application is to that current actual source.

claims.name: Set traces retain their literal types
claims.statement: Restriction preserves unions, converse and intersections as actual relations. A current atom is precisely a nonempty restriction of an old atom with its endpoint unary tags. Equality traces are Id_p on p,p and empty between distinct disjoint types.

claims.name: Actual complete pair and triangle legality includes equality cases
claims.statement: The provider realizes an allowed actual old pair/triangle with the prescribed current bits. If two formal positions agree, use actual equality and compatible type/bit labels rather than inventing a diversity edge between them.

claims.name: Nonempty exact presentations and Top are fixed
claims.statement: Use finite reachable-profile presentations of exact domains. A typed Top is the empty restriction family; on two actual inhabited child sorts its trace is nonempty. Intermediate profile products are actual nonempty represented relations by transitivity and compatible types.

claims.name: Flatten the presentations of all input domains
claims.statement: For exact D_i with nonempty old common intersection, concatenate their finite profile presentations. The resulting old intersection is precisely the given nonempty intersection; omit empty Top presentations.

claims.name: Every flattened constituent meets the same allowed mask
claims.statement: If tr_uv(D_i) is nonempty, a witnessing old atom belongs to D_i and hence every constituent profile of its presentation. Thus each constituent meets the SAME A_uv.

claims.name: Mask primality gives a common traced atom
claims.statement: Apply I02 (P) to the flattened family in C07/C08. Its nonempty old intersection meets A_uv, and actual pair legality realizes the common atom on those child sorts. The empty-family Top case is C06.

claims.name: Nonempty exact-meet trace source export
claims.statement: C07-C09 prove primality for finite exact domains with nonempty old intersection and all traces nonempty. There is no assertion for an empty old intersection.

claims.name: Trace-product forward containment
claims.statement: An actual D witness through v followed by an E witness through the SAME point of v is an old D;E witness between u,z.

claims.name: Fix an actual allowed endpoint orbital
claims.statement: For reverse containment fix x in u,zpoint in z with x(D;E)zpoint. Let c be its actual old orbital, including Id only when these endpoints agree. The whole c lies in D;E by old invariance.

claims.name: First Peirce intersection is nonempty
claims.statement: The actual D;E witness for c gives D intersect ({c};Eop) nonempty by rotating its three positions. F={c};Eop is nonempty exact by I01.

claims.name: The first auxiliary exact factor meets the required mask
claims.statement: Choose b0 in E with a nonempty v,z trace. Apply (T) to the compatible allowed fork c,b0op; its output is an atom of F allowed on u,v.

claims.name: First primality chooses a with its correct phase
claims.statement: D meets the u,v mask by hypothesis and F does by C14, while D intersect F is nonempty by C13. C10 therefore chooses a in D intersect F with an actual u,v trace.

claims.name: The second Peirce intersection remains nonempty
claims.statement: a in {c};Eop gives E intersect H nonempty for H={a}op;{c}; H is nonempty exact by I01. This is a second constrained choice, not a claim the first choice already fixed the b phase.

claims.name: The second factor meets the other required mask
claims.statement: Apply (T) to the allowed fork aop,c, using C15 and the fixed allowed c endpoint pair. The output is in H and allowed on v,z.

claims.name: Second primality chooses b with its correct phase
claims.statement: E and H both meet the v,z mask and E intersect H is nonempty. C10 gives b in that intersection with an actual allowed v,z trace.

claims.name: The chosen old triple is an actual old diagram
claims.statement: b in aop;c witnesses an ACTUAL old a,b,c triangle or equality degeneracy. All prescribed child endpoint masks are allowed; compatibility of any repeated positions is part of the actual pair masks.

claims.name: Actual marking legality realizes this labelled triangle
claims.statement: Use (R)/I03 on the actual old diagram C19 and its prescribed child types u,v,z. This produces a marked realization with an actual middle point in v.

claims.name: Homogeneity aligns the complete endpoint pair
claims.statement: Current homogeneity C03 sends the resulting c-edge to the fixed endpoint pair C12 because full unary/pair types agree. For c=Id align the singleton; repeated input positions use the corresponding equality/two-point diagram. This proves the desired real relation containment.

claims.name: Actual exact trace-product source export
claims.statement: C11/C21 prove tr_uv(D);tr_vz(E)=tr_uz(D;E) as actual relations whenever BOTH input traces are nonempty. The middle sort is v, and logical identities are genuine equality cases.

claims.name: Choose a realized old word and read its prefix types
claims.statement: For a nonempty old word trace choose actual endpoints and an old word witness. In the identified current prefix the same real witness has actual intermediate unary types. Each displayed letter trace is therefore nonempty.

claims.name: A nonempty old word trace is one current word profile
claims.statement: Apply C22 repeatedly along those fixed intermediate types. Its current word profile is exactly the original word restricted to the chosen endpoint types, not merely a subset. The empty old word is the actual current identity.

claims.name: Old nonempty exact traces are current exact
claims.statement: Intersect the current word profiles of C24. A nonempty trace of their old intersection makes all required constituent traces nonempty; Top restricts to current Top.

claims.name: Forgetting a current word gives an original profile
claims.statement: A current word already has compatible fixed intermediate types and realized nonempty letter traces. Repeated C22 identifies it with the trace of its original old word.

claims.name: Every current exact domain has an original exact lift
claims.statement: Write it as a finite nonempty meet of current reachable profiles, use C26 and take the corresponding old profile intersection. A current witness proves that old intersection nonempty.

claims.name: The same assertions iterate across arbitrary prefixes
claims.statement: Induct through the finite stages: nonempty exact domains lift to original domains and trace-product identities compose stagewise. Every use retains the nonempty displayed input traces.

claims.name: Exact-equivalence restriction preserves meets and bounds
claims.statement: Restriction sends old exact equivalences to reflexive current exact equivalences; meets and Id/Top commute with restriction literally.

claims.name: Exact-equivalence joins commute with restriction
claims.statement: Old and current same-sort invariant equivalences commute; their join is represented product by I05. Input traces contain current Id, so C22/C28 makes rho_p preserve joins.

claims.name: A lift of a current exact equivalence contains original Id
claims.statement: Lift current F as tr_pp(D) by C27/C28. Its reflexivity gives one (x,x) in D, and original transitivity gives all Id. Every old relation is symmetric by C02, so D=Dop.

claims.name: Stable powers produce an old exact equivalence with the same trace
claims.statement: The reflexive symmetric invariant D has increasing RAW powers, finite orbital support makes them stabilize, and the stable relation is an equivalence. Each power is exact by I01. C28 with middle p makes every trace F^n=F.

claims.name: Exact-domain and equivalence trace-surjectivity source export
claims.statement: C25-C28 prove both exact-domain directions and prefix products. C29/C30/C32 make rho_p a surjective finite exact-equivalence lattice homomorphism. This is an exact sublattice claim, not a claim every full invariant equivalence is exact.

claims.name: The full fiber join is the largest exact lift
claims.statement: For current exact F its rho fiber is nonempty by C33 and finite. Joining ALL members stays in that fiber by C30, so L_p(F) exists, has trace F and contains every other old exact lift.

claims.name: Largest-lift adjunction is proved in both directions
claims.statement: If H<=L_p(F), restriction gives rho(H)<=F. Conversely if rho(H)<=F, H join L_p(F) has trace F, so its fiber maximality forces H<=L_p(F).

claims.name: The right adjoint preserves all finite meets
claims.statement: H<=L_p(F meet Fprime) iff rho(H)<=F,Fprime iff H<=L_p(F),L_p(Fprime). This identifies L_p of a meet with the old meet; Top follows likewise.

claims.name: The canonical lift uses only exact-equivalence data
claims.statement: C34-C36 distinguish the largest exact lift from an arbitrary predecessor and prove its order properties without declaring the whole FULL invariant lattice exact.

claims.name: All restricted pivot powers are nonempty
claims.statement: A realized current same-sort pivot is invariant and serial in its transitive parent; its positive RAW powers are nonempty. Hence C28 applies with every intermediate sort equal to that parent.

claims.name: An originally nonbipartite atom cannot become a current pivot
claims.statement: An odd old c-walk closes at some point and original transitivity gives Id in that odd power. C28/C38 would put current Id in the corresponding odd current power, contradicting the actual bipartite pivot.

claims.name: All even odd and connectivity relations are literal traces
claims.statement: After C39 proves original c bipartite, its actual even-walk Y_c and connectivity X_c are invariant equivalences with exactly two even-walk classes per connected component. Thus [X_c:Y_c]=2 and c lies in X_c minus Y_c, discharging the finite-relative separating-interval context of I06. Seriality plus finite palette gives stable positive even/odd word profiles; repeated C28 restricts Y,O,X exactly, including nonempty odd trace. X need not be exact.

claims.name: The canonical lifted gate contains original even parity
claims.statement: Y_c restricts below the current gate K_p. By C35, original Y_c<=Ghat=L_p(K_p).

claims.name: The lifted gate is an original complement
claims.statement: Ghat intersect X_c is Y_c or X_c since [X_c:Y_c]=2. The latter would put the nonempty odd trace inside K_p, contradicting the current complement. Thus Ghat intersect X_c=Y_c.

claims.name: Original pivot and maximal-gate source export
claims.statement: Any exact old complement H>Ghat has trace strictly above K_p, because Ghat is the largest lift, and its trace remains a current complement by C40. This contradicts current maximality. C39-C42 therefore prove the original bipartite-pivot and canonical maximal-exact-gate assertion.

claims.name: Type support preserves union converse and identity
claims.statement: All three facts follow from actual witnesses in the fixed prefix. For Id a point has exactly one unary type; diversity loops use distinct real witnesses.

claims.name: Type support preserves represented composition
claims.statement: Align the two actual middle points of matching type with a current automorphism. It preserves old D,F, so the aligned pair gives a D;F witness. Conversely any D;F witness has an actual middle type. This works for ANY old invariant relations, not just exact ones.

claims.name: Equivalence type images are equivalences
claims.statement: Identity, converse and composition preservation send every old invariant equivalence to a reflexive symmetric transitive relation on the type set.

claims.name: Nonempty old exact intersections commute with type support
claims.statement: On any chosen pair of current types, all constituent traces nonempty imply a common traced atom by C10 iterated stagewise through C28. The reverse implication is immediate. Require the OLD exact intersection nonempty.

claims.name: Exact-equivalence type meets always satisfy the guard
claims.statement: A finite intersection of old exact equivalences contains Id, so C47 applies to every such meet; for zero factors use Top and all inhabited type pairs. No assertion is made for disjoint old atomic relations.

claims.name: Every actual class has its complete occupancy class
claims.statement: If an E-class contains an s point and (s,t) is in Phi(E), send a witnessing s endpoint into that class by a current automorphism. Its E-related t endpoint also lies there. Conversely any two types meeting that class are Phi(E)-related.

claims.name: Finite support and occupancy source export
claims.statement: C44-C49 prove represented support homomorphism, exact nonempty meet preservation, equivalence images and exact actual E-class occupancy. Empty old atomic intersections are excluded from the meet claim.

claims.name: Lift a current full exact bridge to original exact D
claims.statement: For current R:p->q with RRop=K_p, choose D with tr_pq(D)=R by C33. D is an ORIGINAL one-sort relation and hence symmetric.

claims.name: The old square has current kernel trace and contains Id
claims.statement: C28 gives tr_pp(D^2)=RRop=K_p. Nonempty symmetric old D is serial, so Id<=D^2.

claims.name: Its stable exact equivalence closure lies below G_p
claims.statement: Stable powers of D^2 are exact equivalences as in C32 and all have trace K_p by C28. Therefore their closure is at most G_p=L_p(K_p).

claims.name: Saturating D produces a whole old G_p correspondence
claims.statement: Put C=G_p;D. Original commutation C02 and Id<=D^2<=G_p give C^2=G_p. Also G_p;C=C=C;G_p, so it is a full exact functional G_p-quotient correspondence, not generally a function on real points.

claims.name: The same old gate lifts the target current kernel
claims.statement: C28 gives tr_pq(C)=K_p;R=R. The reverse trace is Rop and its q-square trace is K_q. Hence G_p is an old exact lift of K_q.

claims.name: Canonical old gates agree throughout the connected component
claims.statement: Largest-lift maximality gives G_p<=G_q; reverse the bridge to get equality. Connectivity propagates this along all active objects.

claims.name: All and only nonempty old G correspondences trace to full bridges
claims.statement: C54 lifts every current bridge. Conversely a full exact original G-quotient correspondence with nonempty p,q trace has trace bridge equations by C28 and is current exact by C33. The FULL chosen component includes that bridge and its target.

claims.name: One original gate per connected step source export
claims.statement: C51-C57 prove equality of all canonical active old gates and the full old/current correspondence. The proof uses ONE original symmetric-sort commutation, not an unspecified mixed relation-algebra commutativity axiom.

claims.name: The finite common old gate meet is exact
claims.statement: Each G_i is an old exact equivalence by C58. Their finite meet contains Id and is exact; with no steps take original Top.

claims.name: The common kernel preserves every prefix label
claims.statement: Induct through the tower: previously related endpoints have the same parent type; in an active parent Kcom<=G_i restricts below its phase gate, so their bits agree. Inactive labels are unchanged.

claims.name: A final label-preserving exact E preserves every prefix
claims.statement: Every prefix label is a coordinate of the final unary label; an old exact equivalence all of whose classes lie in final types therefore preserves each earlier label and each new active bit.

claims.name: Such E restricts below each active phase gate
claims.statement: On active p the exact relations E_p and K_p both preserve the bit, as does their represented exact join. If E_p were not below K_p, maximality I07 would put the WHOLE phase-one involution into this join, contradicting preservation. Thus E_p<=K_p.

claims.name: The adjunction proves largest original label kernel
claims.statement: C35 and C62 give E<=G_i for every connected step; hence E<=Kcom. Together with C60 this proves Kcom is the largest ORIGINAL exact label-preserving equivalence.

claims.name: Common-kernel and type-meet source export
claims.statement: Kcom has classes inside single final types, so Phi_m(Kcom)=Id_T. C48 and C59 give intersection_i Phi_m(G_i)=Id_T, including the zero-step case with its single original type. C63 proves the stated largest exact kernel.

claims.name: Bind the actual exact quotient and stage induction
claims.statement: Fix A04 E. At stage j let Q_j be the ACTUAL E-class quotient of M_j, with occupancy labels D11. Inductively its full labelled age is the quotient safe prefix already constructed; initially it is the actual original exact quotient.

claims.name: Representative parent sorts cover every occupancy object
claims.statement: For every occupancy C choose p_C in C. C49 says every actual E-class of C meets p_C, so that quotient sort is exactly p_C/e_C, where e_C=E restricted to p_C squared.

claims.name: Joint exact quotients supply the actual current source
claims.statement: C33 makes each e_C current exact. Apply the fully NAMED-SORTED simultaneous quotient source theorem I13 to the NEW actual many-parent prefix M_j and these independently chosen kernels. It gives actual finite orbital language, joint homogeneity, AP/JEP, triangle fullness and HOM CCO. Occupancy identifies its carriers with the partitioned old E-classes. No quotient SAP or one-original-sort theorem is substituted.

claims.name: Saturated actual orbital traces obey E7
claims.statement: For a REALIZED old a trace between p_C,p_D, C28 twice gives e_C;(a trace);e_D=(E;a;E) trace. I10 identifies its quotient with one actual current quotient orbital. No nonempty trace is claimed for an arbitrary a.

claims.name: Original quotient atoms plus occupancy labels are complete
claims.statement: For any occurring saturated old quotient atom b choose actual reps in p_C,p_D. Their REALIZED old atom a_prime has the same saturation b by quotient orbital partition. C68 identifies the whole current pair orbital; no hidden finer binary relation remains.

claims.name: Reverse exact descent has its precise one-sort scope
claims.statement: For nonempty original E-bisaturated D=intersection P_r, RAW I01 gives D=intersection E;P_r;E. Each factor descends from an old word, or use I12 directly. Thus D/E is full exact in ORIGINAL M/E. This does not use the STRONG-only saturation lemma or arbitrary mixed reverse descent.

claims.name: Use only the earlier quotient prefix when taking a trace
claims.statement: At stage j, C65-C70 construct the actual full quotient source Q_j before proving stage j+1. Applying C33 or its trace consequences to the quotient tower is allowed ONLY on that already established prefix.

claims.name: Logical quotient identities retain their whole kernels
claims.statement: I10 makes quotient equality pull back to e_C, and gate-groupoid identity pull back to K_p when the proposed gate contains e_C. E=Id is the ordinary tower, while E=Top has one quotient point and no retained step. Distinguish these actual identities throughout.

claims.name: A discarded step is nonrefining on every active parent
claims.statement: If E is not below the common original G_i, C35 gives e_p not below K_p on EVERY active p, since all canonical largest old lifts equal G_i by C58.

claims.name: Its strict current exact join contains the whole odd relation
claims.statement: F_p=e_p join K_p strictly exceeds K_p. I07 puts the WHOLE selected phase-one K_p-quotient involution t_p inside F_p. It acts serially on every gate class.

claims.name: Every individual E-class meets both new children
claims.statement: For arbitrary x in active p choose z with x t_p z. Since F_p=e_p;K_p by same-sort commutation, find y with x e_p y K_p z. Gate K_p preserves the bit while t_p reverses it, so y lies in x E-class with opposite bit. This uses actual marked points and no unmarked-parent automorphism to transport a cross-phase pair.

claims.name: Discarded occupancy classes lift once and keep ALL children
claims.statement: C49 connects all parents of an old occupancy class. C75 makes both children of each active parent occur in EVERY E-class that met it; inactive parents have their unique lift. Thus each old occupancy class has exactly one new occupancy class containing ALL its children. Distinct old occupancy classes cannot merge, so the quotient partition is unchanged.

claims.name: Retained occupancy objects are wholly active or inactive
claims.statement: If E<=G_i and occupancy C meets one active parent, each other parent in C is joined by a nonempty old G_i identity trace. C57 and fullness of the connected component make it active too.

claims.name: Identity G transports are whole current gate bridges
claims.statement: For p,q in such C, I_pq=G_i trace on p,q is nonempty because E<=G_i and occupancy is actual. C28 gives both gate equations; C57 puts this whole exact bridge in the full current groupoid.

claims.name: Choose a coherent objectwise character coboundary
claims.statement: I_pq;I_qr=I_pr by C28 and I_pp=K_p. Their characters satisfy chi(I_pq)+chi(I_qr)=chi(I_pr). Choose p_C and gamma_p=chi(I_pC,p); then chi(I_pq)=gamma_p+gamma_q and gamma_pC=0.

claims.name: The adjusted phase is well defined on each actual E-class
